# Directly posted and genuinely pending records preserve their real lifecycle over HTTP.
env MINA_FX_AUTO_LOAD_ENABLED=false
freeport
exec mina serve --db $WORK/transaction-lifecycle.db --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --quiet &server&
httpget http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health
stdout '"status":"ok"'

httpget -method POST -status 201 -body source_account.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/accounts
stdout '"account_id":5'
httpget -method POST -status 201 -body destination_account.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/accounts
stdout '"account_id":6'

httpget -method POST -status 201 -body directly_posted.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/transactions
stdout '"transaction_id":7'
stdout '"pending_date":null'
! stdout '"pending_date":"'
stdout '"posted_date":"2024-06-01T23:59:59Z"'

httpget -method POST -status 201 -body pending.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/transactions
stdout '"transaction_id":10'
stdout '"pending_date":"2024-06-02T23:59:59Z"'
! stdout '"posted_date":"'

httpget -method POST -status 200 -body post_pending.json http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/records/bulk/status
stdout '"record_ids":\[11,12\]'
stdout '"updated_count":2'
httpget http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/transactions/10
stdout '"pending_date":"2024-06-02T23:59:59Z"'
stdout '"posted_date":"'
! stdout '"posted_date":null'

kill -INT server
wait server

-- source_account.json --
{"fqn":"assets:Integration Source","account_type":"owned","currency":"USD"}

-- destination_account.json --
{"fqn":"assets:Integration Destination","account_type":"owned","currency":"USD"}

-- directly_posted.json --
{
  "initiated_date": "2024-06-01",
  "records": [
    {
      "account_id": 5,
      "amount": "-10.00000000",
      "currency": "USD",
      "posting_status": "posted",
      "reconciliation_status": "unreconciled",
      "source": "manual"
    },
    {
      "account_id": 6,
      "amount": "10.00000000",
      "currency": "USD",
      "posting_status": "posted",
      "reconciliation_status": "unreconciled",
      "source": "manual"
    }
  ]
}

-- pending.json --
{
  "initiated_date": "2024-06-02",
  "records": [
    {
      "account_id": 5,
      "amount": "-12.00000000",
      "currency": "USD",
      "posting_status": "pending",
      "reconciliation_status": "unreconciled",
      "source": "manual"
    },
    {
      "account_id": 6,
      "amount": "12.00000000",
      "currency": "USD",
      "posting_status": "pending",
      "reconciliation_status": "unreconciled",
      "source": "manual"
    }
  ]
}

-- post_pending.json --
{"record_ids":[11,12],"posting_status":"posted"}
